purpose.seed: Repeatable placement variation, separate from all gameplay RNG.
purpose.tree_lod_m: Original near crowns within six metres, original middle crowns to 20 metres, then simplified family silhouettes; shadow-only copies use the far silhouette.
purpose.plant_batch_m: Share small-plant submissions by role in 32-metre cells; cutoff includes the half-cell diagonal so cell edges do not disappear early.
purpose.plant_cutoff_m: Small opaque plants stop submitting beyond readable ground detail; humus and canopy continue.
purpose.shadow_distance_m: Preserve nearby broken light while stopping small foliage and distant crown shadow work.
purpose.shadow_view_m: One orthogonal shadow view covers this short foreground, avoiding four repeated cascade passes; this is a small-walk convention only.
purpose.wind_period_s: One slow shared direction; leaf tips and grounded stems respond differently.
purpose.leaf_tip_m: B1's attached-leaf tip travel, with zero motion at petioles.
purpose.leaf_colour_gain: Subdue the source leaf colours toward weathered olive without changing source textures.
purpose.plant_bend_m_per_m: B2's rooted bend; ground contacts remain fixed.
purpose.pulse_period_s: Inherited ambient four-second scar life, unrelated to work or attacks.
purpose.water_flow_m_s: Slow broad surface flow within the ART-02 stream, no new water physics.
purpose.walk_speed_m_s: Review capsule traversal speed, not player tuning.
purpose.route_start_z: Southern end of this authored ART-02-context walk.
purpose.route_end_z: Northern end of this authored walk; no generated geography is changed.
purpose.candidate_budget: Provisional ceilings for this exact small composition at 1440x900, 4x MSAA, RTX 5090; not a shipping or whole-world budget.
